text: Given a valid flexible asset id, When update_flexible_asset is called with only organization_id set, Then the PATCH payload carries only organization-id and the response reflects the updated organization
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_flexible_assets.py::test_update_flexible_asset_can_set_organization_id -v -> PASSED (1 passed). Asserts PATCH body == {"data": {"type": "flexible_assets", "attributes": {"organization-id": 42}}} and response out["organization_id"] == 42. text: Given an id that does not exist in IT Glue, When update_flexible_asset is called with any valid field (old or new), Then the tool returns the not_found error (regression)
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_flexible_assets.py::test_update_flexible_asset_not_found_returns_envelope -v -> PASSED (1 passed), unmodified. Mocks IT Glue 404, asserts out["error"]["code"] == "not_found". Not re-parametrized with the new fields since the not_found mapping happens before the attribute payload is inspected (same code path for any field set); confirmed by reading src/itglue_mcp/api.py's _status_to_error, which only looks at the HTTP status.
